managers.name: KernelSU
managers.notes: KernelSU is the reference kernel-based root solution. Late-load support is used by temporary-root loaders. A manager alone does not provide temporary root.

managers.name: KernelSU-Next
managers.useFor: Devices a loader names it for
managers.notes: KernelSU fork tracked by GhostSam dirtyfrag payloads (ksud-next).

managers.name: KowSU
managers.useFor: Alternative manager for loaders that support it
managers.notes: Supported by GhostLock App as a ksud provider.

managers.name: BakaSU
managers.useFor: Pixel profiles and other targets that name it
managers.notes: Root My Pixel expects the BakaSU manager named in its README. GhostLock App supports it as a ksud provider.

managers.name: diabl0w KernelSU
managers.useFor: Samsung DirtyFrag and several Galaxy ports
managers.notes: Required on Samsung with DirtyFrag. On some Samsung/Exynos 6.1 kernels, a generic KernelSU module can trigger an EL2 panic during ksud late-load; use target-specific build with CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_NO_PATCH_TEXT=y.
